content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] with [version_no]. For the first time, I configured the network settings (IP address, subnet mask, gateway) correctly and was able to connect to my PC to upload and download programs. However, after navigating through hardware diagnostics via the menu, when attempting to return to the main menu, some menu items disappeared. Now, only 'setup', 'network', and 'diagnostics' are visible on the text display. Any guidance would be appreciated. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Split from direct connection between [article_no] [product_name] and PC.
Closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread with the same subject is published within the conference for [product_name]. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a problem after accessing the hardware diagnostics on their [product_name]'s text display. Returning to the main menu resulted in the disappearance of several items, leaving only 'setup', 'network', and 'diagnostics' options. No errors or explanations were given, causing confusion about the reduced menu.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that after using diagnostic menus, the main menu items should stay unchanged, and all typical options should remain accessible on the display.
